name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain=ui>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor reflects purpose (chapter-intro dialog corner-indicator offsets) and resolves to a flat int32 table. The _b suffix is NOT Ghidra address residue (0x526EA has no 'b' relation): it disambiguates this from the adjacent identical twin *_table_a @ 0x526DA. table_a is consumed by the open/close animation function fd2_animate_tutorial_dialog_intro_or_outro (@ 0x2D669); table_b by the input-wait/blink loop fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink (@ 0x2D85F). _a/_b is a meaningful sibling disambiguator, so keep.
purpose: Chapter-intro dialog corner indicator-sprite offset table: 4 signed int32 framebuffer offsets used to position the four cursor-corner indicator sprites around the chapter-intro speech panel during the input-wait/blink loop.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink (@ 0x2D85F) REP-MOVSDs all 4 dwords (MOV ECX,4; MOV ESI,0x526EA; REP MOVSD) into a local corner_offs[16] stack buffer. The buffer is passed to fd2_render_chapter_intro_dialog_panels each frame. When mode==0 the function additionally iterates i=0..3, loading each element as a signed dword (stride 4) and computing the blit destination as corner_offs[i] + 0xAD430 (framebuffer base) to paint the highlighted/normal corner indicator sprite. The symmetric pairs { -39, -13, 13, 39 } place the four corners around the panel center.
element_semantics: Each element is a signed 32-bit framebuffer byte offset (relative to center) added to base 0xAD430 to position corner i (0..3). Values { -39, -13, 13, 39 } are a symmetric inner/outer pair set for the four panel corners.
notes: Verified against read_memory (bytes d9ffffff f3ffffff 0d000000 27000000 = -39,-13,13,39), Ghidra datatype dword[4] len=16, single user fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink with READ+DATA xrefs only (no writers -> const, matches src 'const int32[4]'). Ghidra plate was null -> created a concise plate via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT (Java API) and save_program (success). src comment block (uitab.c lines 160-175) already precise and accurate -> kept (no Edit needed, uitab.c not modified).
